overview_description.description:
Hisham Hassan, IO Kitchens is Oman’s first and leading cloud kitchen operator. Headquartered in Muscat, the company operates five  facilities across the capital and manages over 50 owned and partner brands.

IO Kitchens’ model blends technology with culinary operations, using data and artificial intelligence to create innovative food concepts tailored for delivery environments. It also offers full operational solutions for other brands, including kitchen management and technical and logistics infrastructure.

Today, IO Kitchens stands at the forefront of Oman’s digital transformation in food delivery, with flexible operational models designed to adapt to market shifts and unlock new growth opportunities.
